notes: crdt.py and run_model.py use only the standard library (hashlib, json, math, random). build_figures.py needs Pillow, and originals/rr7506-cover.png was cropped from the PDF with pymupdf before this run, so re-rendering that file needs pymupdf as well. Both scripts are deterministic: results.json, assets/ and figure-metadata.json are byte-identical across runs (verified by rerunning in a directory outside the repo and comparing with cmp).
